Rae (Growth): proposing a small PLG experiment: 'Launch Lab' 10-min demo, 25-min hands-on lab, 3 short launch posts, and a staggered free-credit test. Goal = increase activation (>=1k tokens in 7d).
Ben (Design): sounds tight but doable. two creative directions: 'Launch Lab: Build Fast' vs 'Launch Lab: Lower Costs'. I'll mock hero cards for both.
Omar (Product): make the lab output-focused: attendees leave with a working endpoint + 3 persona prompt templates. We'll include a starter prompt pack.
Kai (Eng): routing and instrumentation notes: add signup param credit_arm (NOW|LATER). Tag cohort=launchlab-may. If user hits >=1000 tokens in 7d, emit lead_event->growth-sales.
webhook-bot: Form live -> 31 signups in 90m, source=twitter-ad, CTR=3.9% :sparkles:
Rae (Growth): draft short copy (edit as needed):
"Short A: Ship an LLM feature in hours. Join our Launch Lab + get starter credits: https://redwood.ai/launchlab"
"Short B: Build, deploy, measure. Live Launch Lab + starter prompt pack. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/launchlab"
Ben (Design): A is snappier for X, B fits LinkedIn. I'll create a small benchmark card comparing per-token cost vs baseline. Need 95p latency from Kai.
Kai (Eng): pulling metrics now. Also will wire the credit_arm flag and route rules. sample payload: {cohort:launchlab-may, credit_arm:"NOW|LATER"}.
Omar (Product): experiment hypothesis: NOW increases attendance by 15% but LATER increases 7-day activation. We'll randomize at signup.
Rae (Growth): metrics we care about: registration rate, attendance%, 7d tokens, activation rate (>1k tokens), cost/activated-user. Primary KPI = activation rate.
Ben (Design): ETA for assets? I can do hero gifs + benchmark card by tomorrow morning.
Kai (Eng): I can deliver latency/cost numbers + analytics events by EOD.
Omar (Product): I'll finalize agenda & prompt templates.
Rae (Growth): action items: Ben (assets), Omar (agenda + prompts), Kai (routing + metrics), Rae (ads + tracking). Dry run 24h before. Thanks :thumbsup:
